prose: Keith Gladysz is a musician and creator in many artistic mediums. In 2019 he came on InnerVerse to talk about how he overcame Lyme with Eastern Medicine and movement practices. Tonight we'll be talking about his creative journey in the last 2 years since returning to peak condition, and maybe talking about being a home-school dad. Expect dad-gags.
